rv.q: Good luck seeing better acting this year. … the sheer scale of theatricality … A must-see for any theatre fan.

Playing the Lehmans – and all of the other speaking parts, regardless of age or gender - are John Heffernan, Aaron Krohn and Howard W Overshown (Ben Miles’ understudy for the play’s first, covid-affected Broadway run).
Make no mistake, this play is theatre at its very best.

Even when this play is watched again and again, the experience only deepens, not dulls…this masterwork is a monumental achievement. Even though it is largely a work with its head stuck in the past, it stands out as one of the greatest new dramas of this millennium.
...but will certainly appeal less to those more critical minds.
